# CIDEX 2024 — 北京晨晶电子有限公司 (BEIJING CHENJING ELECTRONICS CO,.LTD.) — booth 4067

## Ringkasan

北京晨晶电子有限公司前身是国营第七 O 七厂，主要从事石英晶体元器件以及 MEMS 惯性器件的研发、生产，主要产品包括石英晶体谐振器、石英晶体振荡器、石英 晶体滤波器以及微机械陀螺仪、微机械惯性测量单元和组合导航。 Beijing Chenjing Electronics Co., Ltd. , formerly the state-run 707 factory, is mainly engaged in the development and production of quartz crystal components and MEMS inertial devices, major products include Quartz crystal unit, quartz Crystal oscillator, Quartz Crystal Filters and micromachined Gyroscopes, micromachined Inertial Measurement Unit and integrated navigation.
